notes: Restricted identifier; never commit

definition: Emergency department stay identifier
description: Preferred key for matching ED chief complaint records and annotation rows

notes: Restricted identifier; never commit

definition: Deterministic one-based row number assigned to the private annotation workbook for direct NLP benchmarking

definition: Emergency department chief complaint text
description: Free-text presenting concern used by the classifier
notes: Restricted clinical text; never commit row-level values

definition: Classifier-normalized chief complaint text
description: Lowercased and cleaned presenting-concern text used for segmentation and embeddings
notes: Restricted derived text; never commit row-level values

definition: Serialized segment-level RFV candidate predictions
description: Audit/debug field showing classifier candidates before visit-level aggregation
derivation_or_transformation: Generated from phrase segmentation plus embedding/rule model
notes: Restricted derived text-adjacent payload

definition: Primary NHAMCS Reason-for-Visit short code emitted by classifier
description: First visit-level RFV slot after aggregation
allowed_values: NHAMCS top-level short code or uncodable
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from chief complaint segments and rule overrides
notes: Public only in aggregate

definition: Primary NHAMCS Reason-for-Visit category label
description: Human-readable primary presenting-concern category
allowed_values: 17 top-level NHAMCS RVC groups plus Uncodable/Unknown
validation_rules: must be nonblank for nonempty classified rows
notes: Public only in aggregate

definition: Classifier support text for the primary RFV assignment
description: Short phrase or rule evidence supporting RFV1
notes: Restricted text-adjacent field; never commit row-level values

definition: Embedding similarity score for the primary RFV assignment
description: Numeric score used for classifier confidence/audit
notes: Interpretation depends on classifier threshold

definition: Additional visit-level RFV short codes and labels
description: Secondary presenting-concern categories emitted when multiple categories apply
validation_rules: zero to four additional populated slots
notes: Represented by RFV2-RFV5 column families in private workbooks

definition: Indicator that a qualifying arterial or venous pCO2 threshold was met during the stay
description: Blood-gas cohort inclusion flag
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from ABG PaCO2 >=45 or VBG PCO2 >=50 thresholds
notes: Threshold definitions should match manuscript methods

definition: Indicator that qualifying pCO2 threshold occurred in the first 24 hours
description: Timing marker for qualifying hypercapnia
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from timestamped blood gas data
notes: Retained as timing marker not sole enrollment criterion

definition: Selected pCO2 value used for cohort qualification
description: PaCO2 or venous PCO2 value meeting cohort threshold
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from prioritized qualifying blood gas observations
validation_rules: range and source audited by cohort QA
notes: Restricted row-level lab value; aggregate only

definition: pH matched to the earliest qualifying pCO2 on the same specimen or time-aligned panel
description: Audit field for evaluating whether acidemia analyses can use pH paired to the qualifying PCO2
derivation_or_transformation: Matched by admission, source branch, site, and panel time; exact matches preferred before nearest within narrow tolerance
validation_rules: range audited; may be missing when qualifying panel lacks pH
notes: Restricted row-level lab value; aggregate only

definition: Chart time for pH matched to earliest qualifying pCO2
description: Timestamp supporting paired-pH completeness audits
derivation_or_transformation: Selected from same specimen or time-aligned pH candidate as qualifying pCO2
validation_rules: must be near qualifying pCO2 time when present
notes: Restricted row-level timestamp; aggregate only

definition: Source branch used for the paired qualifying-gas pH
description: Classifies whether paired pH came from the matched LAB or POC branch
derivation_or_transformation: Set from matched pH row when qualifying pH is present
validation_rules: must be LAB or POC when qualifying pH is present
notes: Blank when no acceptable paired pH is available; restricted row-level lab provenance; aggregate only

definition: Sampling site for paired qualifying-gas pH
description: Classifies the matched pH by derived gas site
derivation_or_transformation: Set from matched pH row when qualifying pH is present
validation_rules: must be arterial venous or unknown when qualifying pH is present
notes: Blank when no acceptable paired pH is available; restricted row-level lab provenance; aggregate only

definition: Status of pH pairing for the earliest qualifying pCO2
description: Explains paired-pH availability and missingness for aggregate audits
derivation_or_transformation: Derived during qualifying gas selection without choosing pH availability preferentially
validation_rules: must be one of allowed status labels when qualifying gas exists
notes: Aggregate status summaries are release-safe after privacy review

definition: Source class for qualifying pCO2 value
description: Classifies qualifying gas as ABG VBG or UNKNOWN
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from MIMIC item IDs and source inference
validation_rules: must be one of allowed values
notes: UNKNOWN remains eligible and audited

definition: Indicator for diagnosis-code ascertainment route
description: Marks encounters with hypercapnic respiratory failure or obesity hypoventilation diagnosis codes
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from ICD-10 J96.x2 or E66.2 code logic
notes: Used for nonexclusive ascertainment route summaries

definition: Indicator for ABG-defined hypercapnia route
description: Marks qualifying encounters meeting arterial pCO2 threshold
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from ABG source and threshold
notes: Used in manuscript route-stratified figures

definition: Indicator for VBG-defined hypercapnia route
description: Marks qualifying encounters meeting venous PCO2 threshold
derivation_or_transformation: Derived from VBG source and threshold
notes: Used in manuscript route-stratified figures

definition: Age group used for stratified presenting-concern summaries
description: Grouped patient age at encounter
notes: Exact age bands should match final manuscript table

definition: Severity band based on blood gas pH
description: Used for stratifying presenting-concern prevalence by acidemia severity
notes: Exact pH bands should match final manuscript

definition: Human adjudicated RFV labels for benchmark sample
description: Reference label set used for agreement and NLP benchmark metrics

notes: Private annotation input; aggregate metrics only

definition: NLP-emitted RFV labels aligned to adjudicated sample
description: Classifier label set compared with human adjudication
validation_rules: one or more labels per matched encounter
notes: Report as agreement with adjudicated labels not disease-test sensitivity

definition: Mean multi-label F1 between NLP labels and adjudicated labels
description: Classifier benchmark metric on adjudicated sample
notes: Published abstract reports mean F1 0.67

definition: Chance-corrected agreement metric for benchmark labels
description: Kappa metric for binary/category agreement summaries
notes: Published abstract reports kappa 0.50; sensitive to marginal prevalence

definition: Rate of exact label-set agreement between NLP and adjudication
description: Classifier benchmark summary metric
notes: Published abstract reports 54 percent exact agreement

definition: Rate of partial non-exact overlap between NLP and adjudication
description: Classifier benchmark summary metric
notes: Published abstract reports 21 percent partial matches
